title: Fully discrete stochastic maximal regularity and $H^\infty$-calculus for second-order elliptic operators
summary:
This paper establishes the fully discrete stochastic maximal $L^p$-regularity and the accompanying sharp maximal estimate for numerical approximations of parabolic stochastic partial differential equations.
